title: Women's Equestrian – Horse Girl, Broke on Purpose Embroidered Zip Hoodie
who: the woman who is broke on purpose and has never once regretted a hay bill, zipped on for the barn, the feed store and the show ring.
art: A chestnut horse with a white blaze leans over a weathered barn door and chews a wisp of hay, in rust, cream, blush and sage with a worn print texture.
headline: HORSE GIRL
inks: cream and peach on Black and Navy, brown and navy on Ash
chest: a small horseshoe with a heart inside
warm2: cold barn mornings, muddy paddocks and long drives to the show
gift_line: for the rider who spends every dollar on hay and lessons.
seo_desc: A horse girl zip up hoodie: HORSE GIRL BROKE ON PURPOSE on the back around a horse at a barn door, plus an embroidered horseshoe with a heart on the chest.
